question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**China**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given passage, blank 4 will indicate the object that broke in Paula's living room.**
 
• Now, among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill the blank would be "China."
 
 
• **In this context, "China" means cups, plates, etc. that are made from China.** (चीनी मिट्टी से बने बरतन आदि)
 
• Example: She bought a new set of beautiful China plates.
 
 
 
• The other given options, do not match the context of the given sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

• Tyre: a rubber covering, typically inflated with air, that is placed around a wheel to form a soft contact with the road.(थका देना)
